$comment: Seeded imports for the gate boundaries in .dependency-cruiser.cjs: package-internals-only-through-exports (phase 0 review: a gate opened through a relative import of packages/registry/src/gates/source.ts), gate-test-utils-only-from-proposed (reachable through any chain since round 2 of the review), proposed-tests-only-from-proposed and no-tests-from-apps-or-packages (round 2: apps/api and an indexed case reached the test-utils entry through a tests/proposed/ helper). Same format as tools/eslint-rules/fixtures/seeded/depcruise/expectations.json: each file lists the rule names it must violate, [] means it must pass. The tree is laid over a workspace shaped like the real one (package.json files, entry stubs, node_modules/@sovitech links) and cruised with apps, packages and tests as roots. Everything here is synthetic and sits under a seeded/ path, so ESLint, TypeScript, Vitest, the checks and the real dependency-cruiser run never read it.

before.$comment: The configuration before the first review fix: without package-internals-only-through-exports, each deep import violates nothing.

The configuration before the round 2 fix: gate-test-utils-only-from-proposed saw direct imports only, and no rule covered tests/proposed/ or tests/ as a target. Each chain through a tests/proposed/ helper, and each import of test code from apps/ or packages/, violates nothing.
